summary_en: 1,109,115 shares to be cancelled, 8.0% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). Effective 2026-09-19. Post-cancellation issued share count: 11,014,075. Contingent on shareholder approval of stock split proposal at 2026-09-30 extraordinary general meeting.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Oricon Inc. resolved at a board meeting held on 2026-08-07 to cancel 1,109,115 treasury shares (ordinary shares) under Companies Act section 178. The cancellation comprises all treasury shares held as of 2026-06-10 and represents 8.0% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury). The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on 2026-09-19, contingent upon shareholder approval of a stock split proposal at an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 2026-09-30. Post-cancellation, the company's total issued shares will be 11,014,075.
